title: Fixed-width array field loads and stores
summary: Executes compiler-emitted field addresses, loads, and stores for arbitrary element width, including constant-index consecutive field stores, with exact memory effects and caller-frame preservation.
premises: Exact equality with the emitted field-access region
A combined getter for the pointer and either an encoded index getter or a literal natural index
For each load or store, the wrapped address plus eight lies inside current memory
For a load, the memory word equals the specified value
For stores, the value locals contain the specified words
An operand-stack tail for one access, or an empty stack for consecutive stores, and a continuation consuming the exact result
result: Address calculation preserves the store and pushes the wrapped word address. A load pushes the specified word and preserves the store. A store writes exactly that word, preserves all other store fields and caller locals, and restores the operand-stack tail. Consecutive stores produce writeConstantFields and preserve the complete caller frame.
